1.text: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh<sup foot_note="228292">1</sup> -

footnotes.228292: - i.e., the honor and reputation Allāh had given them as guardians of the Holy Kaʿbah, which allowed them to travel without fear of being harmed.

2.text: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer<sup foot_note="228293">1</sup> -

footnotes.228293: - i.e., the trading caravans that traveled south in winter and north in summer.

3.text: Let them worship the Lord of this House,<sup foot_note="228294">1</sup>

4.text: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
